mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_SN, S.RSVT_NOTI_YN, S.INQR_NOTI_YN, S.STLM_NOTI_YN, S.MKTG_NOTI_YN FROM USER_ACNT U LEFT JOIN OPERATOR_NOTI_SETTING S ON S.USER_SN = U.USER_SN AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE U.USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND U.ACNT_STTS = 'ACTIVE' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE_MST R ON R.ROLE_SN = UR.ROLE_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN ROLE_AUTH RA ON RA.ROLE_SN = R.ROLE_SN AND RA.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN AUTH_MST A ON A.AUTH_SN = RA.AUTH_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE UR.ACTV_USER_SN = U.USER_SN AND A.AUTH_CD = #{requiredAuthority})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPERATOR_NOTIFICATION ( RCVR_USER_SN, NOTI_TYPE_CD, EVENT_KEY, NOTI_TTL, NOTI_BODY, TRGT_TYPE_CD, TRGT_ID, LINK_URL, READ_YN, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT, RGTR_SN, DEL_YN ) VALUES ( #{rcvrUserSn}, #{notiTypeCd}, #{eventKey}, #{notiTtl}, #{notiBody}, #{trgtTypeCd}, #{trgtId}, #{linkUrl}, 'N', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, 'N' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE OPERATOR_NOTI_SN = OPERATOR_NOTI_SN
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ACNT WHERE USER_SN = #{userSn} AND USER_TYPE_CD = 'OPERATOR' AND DEL_YN = 'N')
mapper.sql: FROM OPERATOR_NOTIFICATION WHERE RCVR_USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND REG_DT >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
mapper.select:
SELECT OPERATOR_NOTI_SN, RCVR_USER_SN, NOTI_TYPE_CD, EVENT_KEY, NOTI_TTL, NOTI_BODY, TRGT_TYPE_CD, TRGT_ID, LINK_URL, READ_YN, RGTR_SN, REG_DT
ORDER BY OPERATOR_NOTI_SN DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE OPERATOR_NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y', READ_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{userSn} WHERE RCVR_USER_SN = #{userSn} AND READ_YN = 'N' AND DEL_YN = 'N'
